elements.name: Inspect and cancels the custom line color picker

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a nested sketch in the MCAD Software has Default line color
its geometry properties dialog is open
the user chooses Select from the Line Color list
a color dialog opens with basic color swatches and custom color slots
the user chooses Define Custom Colors
the dialog expands to show a color field, brightness control and color preview
it shows hue, saturation, luminance and red, green and blue fields
it offers Add to Custom Colors
the user cancels the color dialog
the geometry properties dialog shows Default line color
the user cancels the geometry properties dialog
the dialog closes without applying a color change
